name: Orbit Browser Mobile
subtitle: Your web. In your orbit.
promotionalText: Make room for the web: a bottom address bar, visual tabs and a look of your own. Bring Mac spaces, pins and open tabs along with optional end-to-end encrypted sync.
whatsNew: Welcome to Orbit for iPhone and iPad. Discover the compact address bar, visual tabs, custom themes and optional encrypted sync with Orbit for Mac.
description:
Your web. In your orbit.

Orbit is a free browser for iPhone and iPad that gives the web room to breathe. The address bar sits within reach of your thumb, shrinks into a small pill as you scroll, and keeps your tabs a gesture away.

MORE PAGE. LESS CHROME.
Tap to search, swipe across the address bar to switch tabs, or swipe up to see your visual tab overview. Long-press the bar to share, find on page, open Reader or copy a link.

TAKE YOUR MAC WITH YOU.
Optionally connect Orbit to Orbit for Mac. Your spaces, pinned pages, folders and open Mac tabs appear on your iPhone and iPad. Your mobile tabs are available on the Mac too. Sync is end-to-end encrypted through a folder in your own iCloud Drive, unlocked with your recovery phrase.

AT HOME ON IPAD.
Wide displays get a resizable sidebar with three columns of pins. Adjust its width and use keyboard shortcuts for tabs, the address bar and navigation. Resize the window while keeping your current page.

MAKE IT YOURS.
Create themes with colours, gradients and textures. Choose a light or dark appearance, set an accent colour and pick an alternate app icon.

YOUR CHOICE.
Search with Google, DuckDuckGo, Bing or Ecosia. Turn search suggestions off whenever you like. Clear history, tabs and website data in Settings. Orbit has no developer account requirement, developer advertising, built-in analytics or tracking services. Websites and search engines process data under their own privacy policies.

Orbit works on its own. Only optional Mac sync requires Orbit for Mac, iCloud Drive and your recovery phrase. Orbit for Mac is free and open source: https://github.com/SPRTCS/orbit

Requires iOS or iPadOS 26 or later. The app interface is currently in English.
